This position primarily assists the Senior Manager, AML Advisory, in the ongoing oversight, management and enhancement of Equitable Bank’s enterprise-wide AML/ATF and SE financial crimes program. The Senior Analyst, AML Advisory’s role is a multifaceted one. Responsibilities may include regulatory and policy guidance, risk assessment, change initiative reviews, AML/ATF/SE training and stakeholder engagement, ensuring AML/ATF/SE related policy and procedures are understood, maintained, and current. The role supports oversight and effective challenge to First Line businesses to support a comprehensive and effective Regulatory Compliance Management regime within the Bank and manage financial crimes, reputational and other operational risks. The environment is fast-paced and requires effective time management of multiple tasks and projects.

A key function of the role is to assist in providing assurance to the Senior Management on the soundness of underwriting processes and account management routines associated with the portfolio. Another key aspect of the role is to assist in the determination of where Equitable may be exposed to credit or other key risks and identify possible mitigating strategies and/or actions that can be implemented to minimize or eliminate the risk. Developing internal relationships with credit stakeholders is critical to the role.

jobs.description_text: Immuta is the Data Authorization Company, helping the world’s largest organizations control who, and what, can access their data. The way enterprises access data is fundamentally changing. Organizations are racing to put data to work across analytics and AI, while AI copilots and agents are emerging as an entirely new class of data consumer. Immuta provides the authorization layer for modern data and AI. Our platform enables organizations to provision governed access to data by policy, by request, and dynamically for AI agents, so people and AI can access the data they need while enterprises maintain security, compliance, and control. For Chief Data Officers, that means making enterprise data dramatically easier to access and use without giving up governance. For AI leaders, it means giving AI agents secure, governed access to enterprise data so they can move from experimentation into production. Founded in 2015, Immuta is trusted by Fortune 500 companies and government agencies worldwide. jobs.title: Graduate Quantitative Developer
jobs.description_text: About Intropic Intropic provides data and analytics on event-driven situations in global equity markets: index rebalances, M&A, equity capital markets activity and shareholder positioning. Leading hedge funds, asset managers and trading firms worldwide use our forecasts and datasets every day. We are now building our first Asia-Pacific team, in Hong Kong. The Role Intropic is hiring a graduate Quantitative Developer to help build our Hong Kong engineering presence. You'll write production code from day one: the Python and SQL behind the data products traders and researchers rely on, not a queue of tickets. You'll work with analysts to turn research into product, ship to the cloud, and sometimes join client meetings to explain what you've built. You'll be close to APAC markets and clients, with the full backing of our London team. Who we're looking for We hire the person, not the CV. You're a strong coder who's curious about financial markets and wants to own problems end to end. You're comfortable with ambiguity and take pride in clean, well-tested code.

jobs.description_text: About Intropic Intropic provides data and analytics on event-driven situations in global equity markets: index rebalances, M&A, equity capital markets activity and shareholder positioning. Leading hedge funds, asset managers and trading firms worldwide use our forecasts and datasets every day. We are now building our first Asia-Pacific team, in Hong Kong. The Role Intropic is hiring a graduate Research Analyst to cover the events that move APAC equity markets, from index changes across MSCI, FTSE, Hang Seng, CSI, TOPIX and ASX to corporate actions across the region. You'll analyse data, check and improve our forecast models, write research our clients trade on, and talk to those clients directly. It's a fast-learning role with real responsibility from the start, backed by our London research team. Who we're looking for You're analytical, numerate and fascinated by how markets work. You like getting to the right answer, you can explain it clearly, and you want to learn to code (or already do).

jobs.title: Model Engineer & Researcher, US Index Models
jobs.description_text: About Intropic At Intropic, we combine financial market expertise with AI to turn complex information into clear, actionable intelligence. We value curiosity, independent thinking and ownership. The Role We're looking for a Model Engineer & Researcher to own our US index models end to end. Intropic forecasts index rebalances and the passive fund flows they trigger, for hedge funds, banks and asset managers. You'll read each index methodology, implement it in code, validate it against real index outcomes, run it through live review periods, and explain to clients why it forecasts what it does. You'll also build the products clients use on top of those forecasts. Who we're looking for Someone with a strong quantitative foundation that they apply, and real forecasting judgement. You understand what a model's output means in probability terms, which assumptions it rests on and where it breaks. You write fluent Python and SQL, turn messy real-world rules into precise code, and are curious about what drives financial markets.

For internal projects, you will support the new product discovery process through market trends and research, identifying comparable titles for both product and marketing purposes, and assessing market-product fit to help teams make informed product decisions. For external projects, you will provide data, market research, and competitive insights to help the Principal Publishing Product Manager and the team to identify and evaluate new opportunities. This includes creating reports on the business potential and marketability of each product, supporting the creation of financial and revenue forecasts, and contributing to the execution of product, publishing, and marketing strategy. Working closely with the Principal Product Manager, you will help shape the strategic direction of projects, from opportunity assessment and product positioning through go-to-market planning. You will work cross-functionally to align teams around priorities, strategy, and key objectives. Importantly, this role is not limited to assessing opportunities and developing strategy. You will also work directly with the team to execute against the strategy and see projects through the full development and launch cycle, using market insights and performance data to inform decisions and optim

jobs.title: Senior Technical Artist (Contract)
jobs.description_text: And this is where you come in... You possess a combination of strong technical ability, a thorough understanding of art pipelines across modeling, animation and VFX, and a passion for tools and pipelines development and innovation, including optimizing the use of AI. You also have the ability to contribute to VFX production. You are adaptable, you like technical challenges including developing art tools, establishing art strong pipelines and troubleshooting technical issues. You are recognized as a bridge between artists and engineers. You like working with people, helping their growth by teaching industry’s best practices. Sound like a match? Kabam is looking for a contractSenior Technical Artist to join our growing studio in Montréal and evolve how we make games! We don’t just make games, we play and love them too. The Contractor shall provide the following services on an independent, deliverables basis, exercising their own professional judgment, expertise, and methods in performing the Services.

jobs.title: Assembly technician
jobs.description_text: We are investing heavily to deliver the best products to our customers and build the most advanced small satellites out there. We are looking for an Aerospace Technician who wants to be part of our engagement-focused team. Applicant must be an organized self-starter with a passion for quality craftsmanship. You will be part of a team building our constellation of space satellites. You will play a critical role and bring a high standard of workmanship to help ensure conformity to our standards and to achieve optimal performance of all flight hardware. You will be challenged daily and will need to adapt quickly to help us achieve our team’s objectives. You will be focused on integration, soldering, and harness assembly on our next generation of flight spacecraft.

jobs.title: Electrical Design Automation Engineer
jobs.description_text: Please be prepared to share portfolio, Github, etc. in advance to the recruiter welcome call We are looking for an Electrical Design Automation Engineer to accelerate how Kepler designs, analyzes, and verify the electronics inside our satellites. You are an electrical engineer who understands the complete board-development lifecycle—from schematic capture and layout through bring-up, debugging, and verification. Along the way, you have likely found yourself writing scripts or building tools to eliminate repetitive work, improve consistency, and catch problems earlier. In this role you will own the Altium component library, develop automation, and then build and integrate scripted and AI-assisted tools across our electrical design and analysis workflows for years to come. This is a hands-on individual contributor role, working alongside our electrical, FPGA, RF, software, and test engineers where you will combine practical electrical engineering judgment with programming and automation to build tools that engineers can trust, maintain, and use over time.

jobs.title: Embedded Software Designer (Networking)
jobs.description_text: We're on the hunt for a top-tier Embedded Software Designer, who enjoys getting close to the hardware and wants to build the networking software that runs on it. You’ll work with network architects, FPGA developers, and fellow embedded software developers to build and debug networking features on embedded Linux, from customizing Yocto layers and working with memory-mapped peripherals to profiling memory usage on target hardware. You’ll bring hands-on embedded Linux experience and an active interest in networking. Maybe you’ve implemented or debugged a routing protocol, contributed to a networking stack, or built a home lab to experiment with routing and trace where packets get dropped. Experience with routing software or programmable packet processing is a plus, and we welcome experience across networking stacks.

jobs.title: FPGA Digital Design Engineer
jobs.description_text: We’re on the hunt for a top-tier FPGA Digital Design Engineer to develop the next generation of our satellites. At Kepler, you’ll have the opportunity to work with a dedicated team of engineers building the Kepler spacecraft. You will be responsible for the design and implementation of FPGA code either with a focus on DSP algorithms to modulate and demodulate signals on board our software defined radio (SDR), or embedded systems interfacing with processors and peripherals. To be effective you will need to participate in all phases of FPGA design flow (Simulation, Synthesis, Place & Route, Timing Closure and Hardware Testing). A good understanding of the intricacies of FPGA development would make a candidate standout.

jobs.title: Lead (Chief) Satellite Systems Engineer (Contingent)
jobs.description_text: Position Status: Contingent Upon Program Award As a Lead (Chief) Satellite Systems Engineer, you will serve as a primary technical authority for satellite and space-system development programs, ensuring the integrity of system design, integration, verification, and mission readiness from concept through delivery. You will translate program objectives into executable technical plans, aligning requirements, architecture, interfaces, trade studies, verification evidence, and risk decisions across a large cross-functional team. The ideal candidate has demonstrated experience delivering through at least one satellite-level program lifecycle. Experience with constellation-level architectures, multi-satellite delivery, or cross-program technical execution is a strong asset. This role requires strong systems engineering judgment, the ability to lead through ambiguity, and the communication discipline to align teams and stakeholders while balancing technical integrity with cost, schedule, risk, mission assurance, and customer expectations. This position is intended for a technical leader who can operate with credibility across engineering, program management, product assurance, suppliers, customers, and senior leadership. T1/T2 expectations emphasize ownership of technical outcomes, disciplined integration, requirements alignment, decision closure, readiness evidence, and system-wide integration readiness across multiple subsystems.

jobs.title: Senior Electrical Designer & Team Lead - EPS & Mechanisms
jobs.description_text: We are looking for a Senior Electrical Designer & Team Lead to provide technical leadership and support the development of electrical power systems (EPS) and electronics for spacecraft mechanisms. In this role, you will lead the design and development of complex spacecraft electronics, provide technical guidance and mentorship to other engineers, and help ensure hardware is delivered to the required standards of performance, reliability, and quality. You will work closely with cross-functional engineering teams, including RF, mechanical, software, FPGA and systems engineering, to develop and integrate hardware solutions for current and future satellite platforms and customer missions.

jobs.title: Senior Electro-Optical / Infrared Engineer
jobs.description_text: Kepler Communications is seeking an experienced Senior Electro-Optical/Infrared (EO/IR) Engineer to lead the make/buy strategy, design, assessment, trade studies, procurement, integration, and technical oversight of visible and infrared imaging payloads for space-based applications. The successful engineer understands the full signal chain, from photons to bits, and can engage the engineers and suppliers responsible for each key element of the payload. The role focuses on VNIR as well as cooled and uncooled infrared payloads that balance mission performance and product requirements against cost, schedule, and SWaP, and collaborates across Sales & Product, Satellite Systems Engineering, Hardware Engineering, Software Engineering & Perception, Supply Chain, Manufacturing, and Test Engineering.

jobs.title: Senior Embedded Software Designer
jobs.description_text: At Kepler Communications, we're not just imagining the future of on-demand space connectivity - we're leading it! Our mission is to provide real-time on-orbit connectivity for critical missions, enabling a new era of data-driven intelligence and innovation. With 33 satellites launched to date, Kepler operates the first commercial optical data relay constellation, enabling real-time, continuous space communications while supporting advanced on-orbit compute and hosted payload capabilities. Industry-leading technology is only part of the story. What sets Kepler apart is our team: bold thinkers, skilled builders, and passionate problem-solvers who thrive on pushing the boundaries of what’s possible in space. We believe great ideas come from diverse perspectives, and we’re committed to creating an environment where you can grow, lead, and make a global impact. If you’re ready to reach higher, move faster, and do work that shapes the future space economy - this is your launchpad. Come build the future with Kepler! jobs.title: Software Engineering Intern (January 2027)
jobs.description_text: What We Offer: - Build and operate real satellites! - Get hands-on with cutting-edge space technology and real-world engineering challenges. - Dedicated mentorship to support your learning and growth. - Fun and collaborative work environment where you'll learn quickly and feel supported. - Team-building events and opportunities to connect across the company. - Fully stocked Toronto office kitchen with snacks, drinks, games, and top-notch kitchen appliances. - Frequent in-office and company-wide events to stay connected and engaged. - Make a direct impact on Kepler's growth and success. - We’re a certified Great Place to Work® seven years in a row. We’re on the hunt for a top-tier Software Engineering Intern who will assist in developing and maintaining high-performance backend services and infrastructure. You will work closely with cross-functional teams such as satellite operations, ground stations and software development to build scalable applications that support the development, testing, and operation of our satellites and mission control software. You will be trusted from day-one to get hands on with the breadth of our software stack.

jobs.title: 3D Computer Vision Researcher – Arlington, VA
jobs.description_text: Advance 3D Vision Research from Algorithms to Open Source Applications. In this position, you’ll research and develop algorithms for photogrammetry, camera calibration, registration, and 3D reconstruction from images and video. Current projects emphasize aerial and satellite imagery, with opportunities to adapt these capabilities to new challenges and data domains such as underwater imagery and synthetic aperture radar. Your work will contribute to open source applications and frameworks including TeleSculptor, KWIVER, and Danesfield. You’ll also explore how 3D vision can support broader computer vision problems such as object detection and tracking, change detection, super resolution, and video compression. Kitware partners with government R&D agencies, branches of the U.S. military, members of the Intelligence Community, and commercial organizations ranging from startups to Fortune 500 companies. You’ll have opportunities to collaborate directly with customers, participate in field tests and demonstrations, publish novel work, and apply state-of-the-art artificial intelligence approaches to real-world national security challenges.

jobs.description_text: A Flexible, Part-Time Role Helping Keep Our Carrboro Office Running Smoothly Looking for a consistent part-time role with a flexible weekday schedule? As Kitware's Part-Time Office Assistant , you'll help keep our Carrboro office organized and running smoothly for employees, visitors, and collaborators. This position offers approximately 9-15 hours per week, typically 3-5 hours per day on three weekdays. It may be especially appealing to someone who lives near Carrboro and is looking for a convenient, consistent part-time schedule that fits around school, family, or other commitments. You'll handle a variety of hands-on office responsibilities, from welcoming visitors and managing deliveries to maintaining shared spaces and helping with office events. You'll also have opportunities to contribute to general administrative projects and help support the day-to-day needs of our approximately 5,000-square-foot Carrboro office .

Our leadership has a technical background, and there's no middle management layer between you and the problems you're solving. We're not chasing VC rounds or seeking an exit. jobs.description_text: Please note: this is a 12-month contract position. LTA Research is seeking a Learning & Development Project Manager to drive execution of our learning and development priorities. Reporting to the Talent Management Lead, this role will manage LTA’s L&D projects and training operations, including LMS implementation, company-wide training coordination, and support for the Manager Efficacy Program. jobs.description_text: Please note: this is a 12-month contract position with expectations to be Onsite 5 days/week. jobs.description_text: Please note: this is a 24-month contract position. The Senior Environmental, Health, and Safety (EHS) Engineer will lead the development and ongoing management of EHS programs that keep employees safe and company operations in compliance across manufacturing and test activities. This position requires broad EHS experience in a manufacturing or R&D environment and the ability to work independently with engineering, operations, and regulatory agencies. The role is based in Akron, Ohio, with periodic travel to other company locations.

jobs.title: Senior Mechanical Engineer, Hydrogen (CA)
jobs.description_text: LTA Research builds and flies next-generation airships. Our proof-of-concept aircraft, Pathfinder 1, is the largest aircraft flying today, and we operate it as a working test platform to push airship technology forward: moving cargo and people to places without roads, runways, or ports, including disaster relief when infrastructure is cut off. Weight matters in every decision we make. This senior role owns mechanical, thermal, and fluid systems from concept through flight test, with a central part in developing the hydrogen propulsion system for our next aircraft. The base salary range for this role is $135,000 - 160,000, which is determined based on experience, geography, and qualifications. The base salary is one component of the total compensation package, which includes a very competitive annual bonus, 401K Match, and other generous benefits. While we believe competitive compensation is a critical aspect of your decision to join us, we do hope you also spend time considering why our mission and culture are right for you.

jobs.description_text: Long Wall Company was created in 2024 to accelerate missile defense technology for the U.S. and our allies. We specialize in ballistic missile defense and are developing Cyclops, a low-cost, mass-producible interceptor. We also produce containerized launchers and offer low-cost targets for threat replication. This leader will own the technical strategy and execution required to transform mission objectives into reliable, flight-ready systems. The role combines deep technical leadership with team building and cross-functional execution, spanning algorithms, modeling and simulation, embedded software, perception, autonomy, and vehicle-level integration. Successful candidates will know how to move quickly without compromising engineering rigor. They will guide system-level trades, establish scalable technical foundations, and help teams deliver exceptional performance using cost-effective, producible hardware. In hit-to-kill missile defense, every millisecond matters. This role offers the opportunity to build the team and technology responsible for making those milliseconds count. jobs.description_text: Internal Ballistician DESCRIPTION Long Wall is seeking an experienced Ballistician to support the design, development, testing, and production of solid rocket motors (SRMs) for our interceptor system. This role is responsible for ensuring that SRM ballistic performance meets demanding missile-interception requirements while remaining manufacturable at scale. The Ballistician serves as the technical authority for SRM internal ballistics and overall booster performance. Responsibilities include developing and optimizing propellant grain designs; performing SRM performance analysis (including sensitivity to off-nominal conditions); reviewing and interpreting static-fire and flight-test data; providing technical oversight and direction to propulsion suppliers; and defining ballistic requirements and verifying compliance throughout development and production. The successful candidate will establish rigorous analytical methods while driving efficient program execution. They will work closely with propulsion, structures, aerodynamics, guidance and control, manufacturing, and systems engineering teams to ensure ballistic decisions remain aligned with system-level performance, technical baselines, and program objectives The compensation range for this role is $120,000 - $200,000/yr This is the lowest to highest compensation range we reasonably and in good faith believe we would pay for this role at the time of this posting.

jobs.description_text: PROGRAM MANAGER DESCRIPTION Long Wall is seeking a motivated and technically capable Program Manager to support the execution and growth of programs serving the U.S. Department of War (DoW) and other customers. As a key interface between Long Wall and our customers, you will support program execution, customer engagement, and technical coordination, helping keep programs on schedule, on budget, and aligned with contractual requirements. jobs.description_text: As a Senior Data Analyst within our Data Platform team, you will be the subject matter expert behind Kpler’s company and ownership datasets. You will be responsible for ensuring the accuracy, structure and ongoing development of company-level data, including ownership, management, operator and corporate hierarchy information. Your deep understanding of the maritime industry and its corporate landscape will help establish a reliable source of truth for asset ownership, supporting our wider data platform strategy and enabling other datasets, products and teams to build on consistent, trusted information. Starting with maritime companies, you will help expand our coverage over time to include other asset classes and related industries, such as ports, terminals, refineries, commodities and infrastructure. While technical data skills are important, this role places particular emphasis on your industry expertise and ability to translate complex ownership structures into clear business rules and reliable data models. You will also collaborate closely with Product, Engineering, Market Analysts and other Data Analysts to strengthen our data capabilities and support commercial and customer-facing teams.

jobs.title: Senior Data Engineer
jobs.description_text: About the Role As a Senior Data Engineer on our Maritime Models team, you will take technical ownership of the core data pipelines and distributed storage architectures powering Kpler's vessel tracking and predictive analytics. You will design, scale, and optimize high-throughput batch and streaming pipelines that ingest raw maritime telemetry and transform it into actionable intelligence. Working with distributed NoSQL systems like Apache HBase at scale, your work directly ensures the freshness, accuracy, and reliability of the data models our global customers depend on.

jobs.title: Head of Product
jobs.description_text: Join the Future of Robotic Biomanufacturing! Multiply Labs is a robotics company on a mission to solve a significant bottleneck in modern medicine: the manufacturing of life-saving advanced biologics, from gene and cell therapies to antibodies and more. Today, these therapies are produced through manual, labor-intensive processes. Costs are extremely high—often $500K–$2M per patient—limiting access to only a small fraction of those who need them. As product complexity increases and the cost of failure and scientific labor rises, the industry is shifting toward automation. Robotics and AI are making automated biologics manufacturing feasible, reliable, and economically scalable. We believe the future of biomanufacturing is robotic—closed, automated, and scalable—ensuring critical therapeutics are accessible to every patient who needs them. Why This Matters We don’t just build robots—we’re building the essential infrastructure for next generation biologics. Our technology enables biopharma companies to scale production without redesigning their science, reducing regulatory hurdles and lowering costs so these treatments can reach more patients. The Stack & The Scale The Mission: Build the world’s best robots to make life-saving therapies accessible to all. The Technology: Advanced robotic orchestration, high-precision automation, cloud-integrated hardware-software systems, dextrous manipulation, and imitation learning. The Location: Headquartered in San Francisco, CA. The Backin

jobs.description_text: Who We Are; What We Do; Where We’re Going Magnet Forensics is a global leader in the development of digital investigative software that acquires, analyzes, and shares evidence from computers, smartphones, tablets, and IoT-related devices. We are continually innovating so our customers can deploy advanced and effective tools to protect their companies, communities, and countries. Serving thousands of customers globally, our solutions are playing a crucial role in modernizing digital investigations, helping investigators fight crime, protect assets, and guard national security. With employees based around the world, Magnet Forensics has been expanding our global presence. As a part of Magnet Forensics, you can expect to make a difference in the world, no matter what role you play. This role exists to give the Accounting team a dedicated leader, to shorten and de-risk the close, and to bring firm-grade technical rigour to judgement areas that currently escalate to the Controller.

This position is ideal for a hands-on leader who enjoys developing team members, improving processes, and partnering cross-functionally to support business operations while maintaining appropriate financial controls.

In this role, you will help maintain the accuracy and integrity of our global accounts receivable balances by supporting timely customer collections, accurately applying worldwide cash receipts, resolving account discrepancies, and preparing related reconciliations. The successful candidate will be detail-oriented, organized, and comfortable working through complex customer account issues. You will collaborate with teams across the organization and communicate directly with customers to support timely resolution while maintaining a positive customer experience. If you enjoy solving problems, improving processes, and contributing to a growing technology company, we would love to hear from you.

jobs.title: Customer Success Architect
jobs.description_text: Role Overview The Customer Success Architect is part of a highly collaborative team of digital forensic, investigative, and technology subject-matter experts. The team partners across Customer Success, Professional Services, Support, Sales, Product Management, and Engineering to guide customers through implementation, adoption, optimization, and expansion while helping them achieve measurable value from Magnet solutions. As a Customer Success Architect, you will serve as a trusted technical advisor throughout the customer lifecycle - from solution evaluation and design through implementation, adoption, and ongoing optimization. You will help customers deploy and scale Magnet solutions within complex environments by combining deep expertise in enterprise networking, security, cloud and hybrid architectures, integrations, investigative workflows, and troubleshooting with a strong understanding of customer goals and business outcomes. Working closely with Customer Success Managers and cross-functional teams, you will reduce technical barriers, accelerate time to value, strengthen adoption, and establish repeatable technical success practices that scale across the customer base. You will also provide technical continuity at key customer transition points to ensure requirements, expectations, and business objectives remain aligned.

jobs.description_text: Role OverviewWe’re looking for a seasoned Staff Software Engineer who thrives on technical depth and broad influence. You’ve likely led modernization efforts, built shared frameworks or design systems, and enjoy helping others adopt better patterns at scale. jobs.description_text: About the Syndicated Research Team: Penta’s Syndicated Research Team gathers both quantitative and qualitative feedback directly from senior policymakers in Washington, D.C. We examine Fortune 500 companies and major trade associations operating in Washington, drawing insights from the policymakers most relevant to their work. By leveraging this data, we provide clients with actionable intelligence to strengthen their advocacy, positioning, and engagement strategies in the federal policymaking landscape. The Role: Penta is actively looking for a Quantitative Research Associate to join its Policymaker Research team. Each year, Penta conducts several studies with federal and state policymakers and other key stakeholders to understand their perceptions of prominent companies, associations, and nonprofits. The ideal candidate will have professional or academic experience using systems like STATA and/or R on large and complex datasets. This role sits at the heart of our quantitative research practice, ensuring the rigor, accuracy, and reliability of our data. jobs.title: Associate Director, Marketing
jobs.description_text: Role Summary Lexeo’s Commercial team is building the strategy, insights, brand and infrastructure required to bring LX2006 to patients – marking Lexeo’s transition from a clinical-stage to a commercial company. We are seeking an Associate Director, Marketing to play a central role in preparing for the launch of LX2006, Lexeo’s first commercial product, anticipated in the US in 2028 and globally thereafter. Reporting to the Senior Director, Marketing, this individual will serve as the LX2006 brand lead, owning critical launch workstreams end to end – from customer insights and competitive intelligence to market development, campaigns, customer targeting and launch readiness – and working closely with cross-functional partners in Market Access/HEOR, Medical Affairs, Patient Affairs, Clinical Development, Regulatory, Legal, CMC, and Business Development (ad hoc) as part of Lexeo’s Launch Readiness Team. The role will also support early commercial planning for LX2020, Lexeo’s gene therapy candidate for PKP2-associated arrhythmogenic cardiomyopathy. This is a highly visible, hands-on opportunity to build a launch from the ground up and help shape the commercial foundation of a growing clinical stage company.

This highly cross-functional role will evaluate new geographies, trial models, and other approaches that could improve the speed, efficiency, and execution of clinical development across Lexeo’s portfolio. The individual will also translate complex clinical, scientific, and regulatory information into clear, compelling communications for patients, healthcare professionals, media, investors, and other external audiences. This role will sit within the Clinical organization and partner closely with Medical Affairs, Patient Affairs, Investor Relations, and other functions. A successful candidate will combine strategic thinking with hands-on execution and will have the opportunity to shape high-priority initiatives across clinical development, communications, and corporate strategy.

The scientist will design, perform or manage rodent studies from target validation through hit identification, working cross-functionally with In Vitro Pharmacology, Modality Engineering, and Translational Sciences to select-advance molecules. Reporting to the Head of Cardiac Research, this role joins cardiac, neuroscience, and non-clinical scientists developing therapies for genetic heart disease and offers broad experience in multidisciplinary biopharma research.

jobs.title: Scientist I/II, Modality Engineering
jobs.description_text: Role Summary Lexeo is hiring a hands-on Modality Engineering Scientist to design, synthesize, and characterize oligonucleotides, bioconjugates, and AAV therapeutics for our discovery pipeline. Reporting to the Head of Cardiac Research, this role joins cardiac, neuroscience, and non-clinical scientists developing therapies for genetic heart disease and offers broad experience in multidisciplinary biopharma research.

jobs.description_text: Denver, CO (Preferred) Open to Remote Candidates ROLE OVERVIEW Pivot Energy is seeking a motivated and self-directed Senior Accounting Manager, Debt & Corporate, to join our Accounting and Finance Team, headquartered in Denver. This role owns the accounting, compliance, and reporting for Pivot’s growing debt portfolio – including warehouse, construction, term loan, and delayed-draw facilities and the related interest rate swaps – and is responsible for the accounting review and execution of quarterly joint venture (JV) and fund distributions. The position is also a key contributor to corporate, borrower-entity, and lender financial reporting. This role partners closely with Treasury, Project Finance, Asset Management, Portfolio Accounting, and FP&A, and serves as the primary accounting point of contact for lenders, administrative agents, depository banks, and auditors on debt and distribution matters. This is an exciting, fast-paced industry requiring creative thinking and problem-solving skills to succeed. In this capacity, you'll be responsible for adhering to standard operating procedures, managing community solar data, supporting customers, reporting business results, escalating issues, proposing solutions and supporting other projects as assigned by your manager. This role combines aspects of engineering, collaboration with finance, operations, and policy teams with a goal of deploying and optimizing our storage pipeline. The Director will work with the market strategy, policy, and finance teams on revenue modeling and financial analysis, and with Estimation, Procurement, and Commercial Operations to optimize CAPEX and OPEX. jobs.description_text: ROLE OVERVIEW The Manager, Project Finance is responsible for leading the financing of Pivot Energy’s projects. This position will drive key activities with internal and external stakeholders to deploy capital and bring project portfolios online across key markets. The Manager will oversee due diligence, data rooms, and cash flow forecasts to ensure timely project financings. The Manager owns the financing outcome for assigned facilities, facilitates the negotiation and structuring of financing arrangements, and directs the work of Senior Associates and Associates. It is an exciting opportunity to join a dynamic Finance department within a growing organization. There are many moving pieces to financing solar projects, and the ability to effectively prioritize, organize, and communicate is paramount. This role will contribute to capital raising and deal structuring efforts, applying a deep understanding of renewable project financing structures and concepts. COMPENSATION & BENEFITS The base salary range for this position is $110,000 - $140,000 depending on relevant experience, along with eligibility for the company’s substantial bonus plan, with a target bonus of 30% of annual salary (prorated in the first year based on start date).

jobs.description_text: Location: Denver, CO (Preferred) Remote candidates will be considered ROLE OVERVIEW Pivot Energy is seeking a dynamic, experienced leader to join our team as Vice President (VP) of Market Strategy & Policy. jobs.description_text: About the role As Director of Field Marketing at Quandri reporting to the CMO, you’ll establish the strategy, operating rhythms, and measurement needed to generate demand for Quandri’s software in our first priority regions. As the program grows, you’ll hire and lead marketers dedicated to individual regions. You’ll work closely with regional Sales teams to understand their markets, target accounts, and pipeline goals. You’ll turn those priorities into a focused mix of hosted events, sponsored conferences, executive dinners, meetups, local digital programs, and other tactics you think are relevant and meaningful. The industry is insurance, and the events are fun: think golf tournaments, baseball games, community get-togethers and more. This is a hands-on role: you’ll set the direction and personally deliver programs while building the team. You will: Build the field marketing plan for Quandri’s first defined regions, deciding where to invest and developing repeatable programs that can scale. Manage field events from start to finish, including venues, vendors, staffing, on-site materials, and execution. For each major event, agree with Sales on the accounts to reach, meetings to book, and opportunities to advance. Plan outreach before the event, secure clear next steps during it, and ensure timely, personalized follow-up is recorded in HubSpot. Set goals for meetings, qualified opportunities, and sourced and influenced pipeline. Report results and use them to refine the plan.
